description: ID3v2.4 frames whose data length indicator (section 4.1.2 p) disagrees with their data: an unsynchronized TIT2 and a PRIV frame that both claim 99 bytes. The sizes shown are the measured ones.

findings.contains: Frame TIT2 at 0xA has a data length indicator of 99 bytes, but its data is 5 bytes
